verdict.rationale: Portkey documents SDK-style integration (base URL swap for OpenAI Python/Node SDKs, REST API reference, open-source gateway installable via npx) supporting AI-native builders, but the evidence pack lacks explicit mention of dedicated first-party SDKs beyond OpenAI-compatible drop-in usage, and OpenAPI spec probes returned 404s. missing for 10: dedicated official multi-language SDK docs (e.g., Python/JS Portkey SDK reference pages), working OpenAPI/spec discovery, independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
